categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Jingsheng Mechanical & Electrical Co., Ltd. primarily operates in semiconductor equipment manufacturing, semiconductor substrate materials, and semiconductor consumables and precision components. Its product portfolio includes crystal growth equipment, intelligent processing equipment, sapphire materials, silicon carbide substrates, quartz crucibles, and precision parts. The company serves the semiconductor, compound semiconductor, and photovoltaic industries with a comprehensive equipment and materials supply chain.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies such as crystal growth (Czochralski and zone melting methods), chemical vapor deposition (CVD, PECVD, LPCVD, MPCVD), atomic layer deposition (ALD), and precision machining for semiconductor wafers and substrates. It also develops proprietary equipment for silicon and compound semiconductor wafer processing, including epitaxy, polishing, thinning, and cutting. The production methods emphasize automation, digitalization, and intelligent manufacturing to enhance efficiency and product quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading semiconductor material manufacturers and chip fabricators such as Zhonghuan, Shanghai Xinxing, Eswee, and others. The company serves semiconductor wafer manufacturers, chip manufacturers, packaging and testing enterprises, and photovoltaic module producers. Its markets span integrated circuit manufacturing, compound semiconductors (SiC, GaN), and renewable energy sectors, particularly photovoltaic installations.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with headquarters and major facilities in Zhejiang Province and subsidiaries in regions including Inner Mongolia, Ningxia, and Hong Kong. It has expanded its international presence with subsidiaries and operations in Japan, Singapore, Malaysia, and other countries, serving global customers in Asia, Europe, and the Americas.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhejiang Jingsheng operates across multiple points in the semiconductor and photovoltaic supply chain, including upstream substrate material production (sapphire, silicon carbide, diamond), midstream semiconductor equipment manufacturing (crystal growth, epitaxy, wafer processing), and downstream consumables and precision components supply. It plays a critical role in domestic equipment and material supply, supporting the localization of semiconductor manufacturing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in advanced semiconductor equipment and materials, focusing on 8-12 inch silicon wafer equipment, compound semiconductor (SiC) epitaxy and processing, and photovoltaic equipment innovation. It invests heavily in developing 12-inch silicon epitaxy, advanced thinning and polishing equipment, and optical-grade SiC substrates. Digitalization, intelligent manufacturing, and integration of equipment and materials are key themes, alongside expanding product lines in semiconductor consumables and precision parts.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of semiconductor and photovoltaic equipment, materials, and consumables. The company uses a prepayment-sales-acceptance payment model for equipment and a prepayment-delivery-invoice payment model for materials. It also earns income from after-sales services, technical support, and licensing of proprietary technologies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in semiconductor equipment and materials, with a strong position in 8-12 inch silicon wafer equipment and SiC substrate production. It competes with international giants in advanced semiconductor equipment but has achieved significant breakthroughs in domestic localization and market share. Its photovoltaic equipment segment holds a global leading position in single crystal silicon growth furnaces and related technologies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 17.58 billion, a slight decrease of 2.26% year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 2.51 billion, down 44.93%. The company maintains substantial assets totaling over RMB 31.5 billion and continues to invest heavily in R&D with over RMB 1.1 billion spent in 2024. Despite short-term profit declines, the company is expanding its production capacity and market reach, including establishing new subsidiaries internationally.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhejiang Jingsheng emphasizes advanced technology integration, high product quality, and comprehensive industry chain coverage from materials to equipment and consumables. Its competitive differentiation lies in its domestic leadership in large-diameter silicon wafer equipment, pioneering compound semiconductor substrate production, and innovative photovoltaic equipment solutions. The company offers customers enhanced efficiency, cost reduction, and supply chain security through localized production, intelligent manufacturing, and tailored technical services.
